data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/manifest-v60/action.schema.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Per-role schema for manifests/<saas>/actions/<verb>.yaml body (post-_meta-strip). Spec 70 update: accepts optional `mcp_tool:` pointer at the action level; per-flavor `recipe` is required ONLY for the `browser` flavor — the `oauth_api` flavor declares an inline `request:` block (provider/method/url/query) issued by the runtime oauth_api transport; session_api / byok_api flavors use an `api:` reference; the `mcp` flavor uses `server:` + `tool:`. Runtime validator enforces step-type vocabulary inside recipe[] and the ApiDef shape inside `call_platform_api` args (kind: aura | gapi | rest_session as of 1.2.0).
data_cdn_meta.regenerate_requires: spec 60.3 §D3.5 — TS source-of-truth generator path; currently hand-rolled.

title: Spec 70 — actions/<verb>.yaml body
description: Validates the body of a per-SaaS action recipe file (e.g. manifests/gmail/actions/send_email.yaml) after _meta is stripped. description + flavors required.

object.description: Entity name this action operates on (e.g. Message, Thread).

object_types.description: When `object:` is a runtime template (e.g. "{{inputs.object_type}}"), enumerate the valid runtime values here so validate-views + propose-time check can resolve schemas/<Type>.yaml for each.

commits_changes.description: Whether this action mutates server-side state. Drives commit-confirmation UX + the runtime's transport priority (commits_changes:true → prefer browser > API; false → prefer API > browser).

depends_on_view.description: View the user must be in before this action can run (e.g. ComposePanel for send_email). Pre-navigation runs only for the `browser` flavor; API flavors skip it.

mcp_tool.description: Optional pointer to the matching entry in MCP_TOOL_CATALOG (_mcp_tools.yaml). Format: <server>.<tool_name>. Per spec 70 §3, atom actions whose verb maps to an MCP tool carry this pointer as authoring provenance.

flavors.description: Map of flavor id (browser, oauth_api, session_api, byok_api, mcp) → flavor definition. At least one flavor required. The `browser` flavor requires `recipe`; the `oauth_api` flavor requires `request:`; session_api / byok_api require `api:`; the `mcp` flavor requires `server:` + `tool:`.

api.description: Reference to an apis.yaml entry (used by session_api / byok_api flavors).

request.description: Inline OAuth-bearer REST call (used by the oauth_api flavor). Issued by the runtime oauth_api transport. Shape: { provider, method, url, query? }.

server.description: MCP server identifier (used by `mcp` flavor; matches the `server.name` field in _mcp_tools.yaml).

tool.description: MCP tool name within the named server (used by `mcp` flavor; matches a tools[].name entry in _mcp_tools.yaml).

inputs_map.description: Optional input-shape mapping for the flavor (e.g. mcp flavor's `operation: insert` constant fed alongside the action's inputs).

oneOf.description: oauth_api flavor: inline OAuth-bearer REST request.
